name: Giving her a Voice
source:
A kinetic VN about an antisocial non-binary girl whose wealthy family gives her an android clone to handle her social responsibilities. 

It seems like a dream come true – but if the android can do everything for her, what’s the point in the end?

[From [url=https://suryce.itch.io/giving-her-a-voice-vn]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一部充满活力的VN，讲述了一个反社会的非二元女孩的故事，她的富裕家庭给了她一个机器人克隆人来履行她的社会责任。

这似乎是梦想成真——但如果机器人能为她做一切，那到底有什么意义呢？

[来自[url=https://suryce.itch.io/giving-her-a-voice-vn]Itch.io[/url]]
